# Salome Mosiava

> Senior Product Designer and Art Director based in Tbilisi, Georgia. UX/UI product design, art direction, social media visual design, motion design and brand identity for startups and enterprises. 80+ projects shipped over 6+ years; Top-Rated Plus on Upwork (top 3%).

Salome designs digital products end to end, from research and flows to design systems and developer handoff, and leads visual direction for brands across social media and motion. She is available for freelance projects, collaborations and full-time roles.

## Case studies

- [AURUM, crypto exchange](https://samole.ge/projects/aurum): Lead UX/UI for a regulated crypto exchange for the Georgian market. 196 screens, 64+ components, a full design system, trust-first onboarding and verification flows. Web and mobile.
- [SCHENKER, logistics platform](https://samole.ge/projects/schenker): Enterprise shipment management with document workflows and API integration. Form architecture and a dev-ready spec for a B2B desktop product.
- [Unispace, student management platform](https://samole.ge/projects/unispace): Multi-role EdTech platform for Unilab at Ilia State University. 42+ screens, 38+ components, three roles (student, lecturer, admin) and a conditional form system.

## Work

- [UX/UI design](https://samole.ge/work/ux-ui): Overview of the product design case studies.
- [Social media ads](https://samole.ge/work/social-media-ads): Campaign visuals and art direction for Terminal, Mardi Holding, Crystal Leasing, Gino Aquapark, Carmall, Scope and more.
- [Social media motion](https://samole.ge/work/social-media-motion): Logo reveals, reels and brand animation for Carmall, Scope, Saloni Furniture and more.
